spec.name: omp-persona-badge
spec.intent: Project the persona badge on omp. A third per-persona extension module, filename OMP_PERSONA_BADGE_MODULE = `${CLI_BIN}-persona-badge.ts` (render.ts, beside OMP_GUARDRAIL_MODULE and OMP_SESSION_MODULE, added to OMP_EXTENSION_FILES so scopedRel lands it at agent/personas/<name>/extensions/), emitted once per projected agent with scope = that agent name and never for SESSION_SCOPE. Its text bakes the status literal at projection with JSON.stringify: "<mark.emoji> <name>" when provenance is non-null, "<name>" alone when provenance is null; the hue is never read. Its default export registers session_start and calls ctx.ui.setStatus(<key>, <text>) only when ctx.hasUI and ctx.agent.kind === "main"; the key is derived from CLI_BIN, never spelled. Banner matches the sibling modules (GENERATED by @cratylus/forge, regenerate with the interpolated `${CLI_BIN} project`) plus the persona placement note; no env var, no runtime persona check, no exec. PROVENANCE REACHES THE ADAPTER THROUGH THE PORT: HarnessAdapter.launchSurface widens from agentNames: readonly string[] to the composed agents: readonly Agent[] (its doc amended: the identity a harness with no native identity field carries now includes the badge); project/index.ts passes each rendered agent exactly once (NOT the composed array, which holds every agent twice after the render loop re-pushes it, observed at project/index.ts:514 and :569); ompHarnessAdapter.launchSurface returns ompLaunchSurface(agents.map(a => a.name)) followed by a new exported ompPersonaBadgeExtensions(agents), re-exported with the constant from adapters/omp/index.ts. ompLaunchSurface keeps its signature; guardrail and session modules untouched. omp.test.ts pins one badge per agent at personas/<name>/extensions via scopedRel, none at session scope, emoji+name text, name-only text for null provenance, no hue, the main+UI guard. forge README omp placement table gains the badge row and the launchSurface prose names it; a changeset (@cratylus/forge minor) states the badge and the breaking launchSurface signature for out-of-tree HarnessAdapter implementers.
accept: After `pnpm build && pnpm exec cratylus project --harness omp --out /tmp/pb-omp`, print N = count of /tmp/pb-omp/agents/*.md (7 at census 2026-09-28; re-derive) and M = count of /tmp/pb-omp/enforcing/*/cratylus-persona-badge.ts; for every agents/<name>.md the file enforcing/<name>/cratylus-persona-badge.ts exists and M = N (fails today: M = 0)

/tmp/pb-omp/enforcing/_session/cratylus-persona-badge.ts does not exist, and ompHarnessAdapter.scopedRel("cratylus-persona-badge.ts", "nico") === "agent/personas/nico/extensions/cratylus-persona-badge.ts" (pinned in omp.test.ts)

/tmp/pb-omp/enforcing/nico/cratylus-persona-badge.ts contains the literal "📐 nico" (with double quotes), contains `setStatus(`, contains `hasUI`, and matches /agent\.kind\s*===\s*["\x27]main["\x27]/ (fails today: file absent)

No badge file under /tmp/pb-omp/enforcing/*/cratylus-persona-badge.ts matches `grep -iwE "blue|red|white|magenta|green|cyan|yellow"` (the 7 canon hues at census), while each contains its own agent mark emoji

A test in packages/forge/test/adapters/omp.test.ts calls ompHarnessAdapter.launchSurface with an agent { name: "x", provenance: null } and asserts exactly one projection with filename cratylus-persona-badge.ts and scope "x" whose setStatus text literal is exactly "x"; the test fails if the text carries anything beyond the name
`git grep -n persona-badge -- packages/forge/README.md` is non-empty and `git grep -li "persona badge" -- .changeset` names a file whose front matter is `"@cratylus/forge": minor` (both fail today)
`git grep -nF "cratylus-persona-badge" -- packages/forge/src` is empty: the filename and the status key derive from CLI_BIN, never spelled
Green: `pnpm --filter @cratylus/forge test`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm typecheck:test`, `pnpm lint`, and `pnpm verify` (build, lint, project all three harnesses, full test incl. canon harness-parity)
